BENILLA_INBOXITEMS_TO_DISPLAY = 7 -- INBOXITEMS_TO_DISPLAY (ref MailFrame.lua l.1) BENILLA_MAX_COD_AMOUNT = 10000 -- MAX_COD_AMOUNT (ref l.6) BENILLA_STATIONERY_PATH = "Interface\\Stationery\\" -- STATIONERY_PATH (ref l.5)
-- The money entry uses the shared BenillaMoneyInput_* kit (MerchantFrame.xml, loaded first) — -- the send tab's three numeric edit boxes are named SendMailMoneyGold/Silver/Copper.
-- ── Load / event dispatch (ref MailFrame_Onload l.8-24 / MailFrame_OnEvent l.26-62) ────── function BenillaMailFrame_OnLoad(frame) frame.pageNum = 1 PanelTemplates_SetNumTabs(frame, 2) PanelTemplates_SetTab(frame, 1) frame:RegisterEvent("MAIL_SHOW") frame:RegisterEvent("MAIL_INBOX_UPDATE") frame:RegisterEvent("MAIL_CLOSED") frame:RegisterEvent("MAIL_SEND_SUCCESS") frame:RegisterEvent("MAIL_FAILED") -- The send tab's player-money purse (ref SmallMoneyFrameTemplate refreshes itself on -- PLAYER_MONEY; the merchant-window precedent). frame:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_MONEY") end
function MailFrame_OnEvent() local frame = this if event == "MAIL_SHOW" then ShowUIPanel(frame) if not frame:IsVisible() then CloseMail() return end OpenBackpack() SendMailFrame_Update() MailFrameTab_OnClick(1) CheckInbox() -- drains to CMSG_GET_MAIL_LIST (throttled app-side, wow-re §5) elseif event == "MAIL_INBOX_UPDATE" then InboxFrame_Update() OpenMail_Update() elseif event == "MAIL_SEND_SUCCESS" then -- Fires on a successful send AND, byte-verified, on window open (the compose-tab -- reset side effect — wow-re §5); either way reset the form + play the page turn. SendMailFrame_Reset() PlaySound("igAbiliityPageTurn") if SendMailFrame.sendMode == "reply" then MailFrameTab_OnClick(1) end elseif event == "MAIL_FAILED" then -- Fires on EVERY SMSG_SEND_MAIL_RESULT for a send (success included, wow-re §5): its -- only job is to re-enable the button so the UI never stays blocked. SendMailMailButton:Enable() elseif event == "MAIL_CLOSED" then HideUIPanel(frame) elseif event == "PLAYER_MONEY" then -- Repaints the purse AND recolors the postage cost (ref: both money frames -- self-refresh on this event). SendMailFrame_Update() end end
-- THE TWO SKINS the window wears (ref MailFrameTab_OnClick l.64-93). The inbox is dressed in -- the item-text parchment, the compose form in the class-trainer panel; four corner slabs -- and the top-left slab's own offset are the whole of the difference between them, so they -- are a table here rather than two copies of the same five calls. `$parentTopLeft` and its -- siblings publish as MailFrameTopLeft…, which is what the corner keys compose. local mailSkin = { inbox = { TopLeft = "Interface\\ItemTextFrame\\UI-ItemText-TopLeft", TopRight = "Interface\\Spellbook\\UI-SpellbookPanel-TopRight", BotLeft = "Interface\\ItemTextFrame\\UI-ItemText-BotLeft", BotRight = "Interface\\Spellbook\\UI-SpellbookPanel-BotRight", x = 0, y = 0, }, compose = { TopLeft = "Interface\\ClassTrainerFrame\\UI-ClassTrainer-TopLeft", TopRight = "Interface\\ClassTrainerFrame\\UI-ClassTrainer-TopRight", BotLeft = "Interface\\ClassTrainerFrame\\UI-ClassTrainer-BotLeft", BotRight = "Interface\\ClassTrainerFrame\\UI-ClassTrainer-BotRight", -- The trainer art does not sit flush the way the parchment does; the ref's own -- one-pixel nudge is what lines the two skins' outer edges up. x = 2, y = -1, }, } local mailCorners = { "TopLeft", "TopRight", "BotLeft", "BotRight" }
-- Tab 1 is the inbox; anything else is the compose form. function MailFrameTab_OnClick(tab) if not tab then tab = this:GetID() end PanelTemplates_SetTab(MailFrame, tab)
local reading = (tab == 1) if reading then InboxFrame:Show() SendMailFrame:Hide() else InboxFrame:Hide() SendMailFrame:Show() end
local skin = reading and mailSkin.inbox or mailSkin.compose for _, corner in ipairs(mailCorners) do getglobal("MailFrame" .. corner):SetTexture(skin[corner]) end MailFrameTopLeft:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "MailFrame", "TOPLEFT", skin.x, skin.y)
if not reading then -- Arriving at the form repaints it and clears the mode a Reply had set -- (SendMailFrame_Update never reads the mode, so the order is free). SendMailFrame.sendMode = "send" SendMailFrame_Update() end PlaySound("igSpellBookOpen") end
-- ── Inbox (ref InboxFrame_Update l.97-199): the row's clickable child is $parentButton, so -- every getglobal below reads MailItem<i>Button* / MailItem<i>Sender/Subject/ExpireTime. ─ function InboxFrame_Update() local numItems = GetInboxNumItems() local index = ((MailFrame.pageNum - 1) * BENILLA_INBOXITEMS_TO_DISPLAY) + 1 for i = 1, BENILLA_INBOXITEMS_TO_DISPLAY do if index <= numItems then local packageIcon, stationeryIcon, sender, subject, money, CODAmount, daysLeft, hasItem, wasRead, x, y, z, isGM = GetInboxHeaderInfo(index) local icon if packageIcon and not isGM then icon = packageIcon else icon = stationeryIcon end if not sender then sender = "Unknown" end -- UNKNOWN local button = getglobal("MailItem"..i.."Button") button:Show() button.index = index button.hasItem = hasItem getglobal("MailItem"..i.."ButtonIcon"):SetTexture(icon) local subjectText = getglobal("MailItem"..i.."Subject") subjectText:SetText(subject) local senderText = getglobal("MailItem"..i.."Sender") senderText:SetText(sender) -- Unread gold / read grey (ref l.130-141; the read icon's SetDesaturation is -- still our vertex-grey stand-in — see this file's header for why 1327's real -- desaturation has not been wired in here yet). if wasRead then senderText:SetTextColor(0.75, 0.75, 0.75) subjectText:SetTextColor(0.75, 0.75, 0.75) getglobal("MailItem"..i.."ButtonSlot"):SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) getglobal("MailItem"..i.."ButtonIcon"):SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) else senderText:SetTextColor(1.0, 0.82, 0) -- NORMAL_FONT_COLOR subjectText:SetTextColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) -- HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR getglobal("MailItem"..i.."ButtonSlot"):SetVertexColor(1.0, 0.82, 0) getglobal("MailItem"..i.."ButtonIcon"):SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) end -- Expiry: green whole days, red under a day (ref l.142-149: GetText("DAYS_ABBR") -- pluralizes — DAYS_ABBR "Day" / DAYS_ABBR_P1 "Days", GlobalStrings l.895-896; -- the sub-day SecondsToTime is approximated as "< 1 day"). local expireTime = getglobal("MailItem"..i.."ExpireTime") if daysLeft >= 1 then local days = math.floor(daysLeft) expireTime:SetText(string.format("|cff20ff20%d %s|r", days, days == 1 and "Day" or "Days")) else expireTime:SetText("|cffff2020< 1 day|r") end -- The expiry tooltip (ref l.150-155). if InboxItemCanDelete(index) then expireTime.tooltip = "Time until message is deleted" -- TIME_UNTIL_DELETED else expireTime.tooltip = "Time until message is returned" -- TIME_UNTIL_RETURNED end expireTime:Show() -- COD tag (ref l.157-164) + money field. if CODAmount > 0 then button.cod = CODAmount getglobal("MailItem"..i.."ButtonCOD"):Show() else button.cod = nil getglobal("MailItem"..i.."ButtonCOD"):Hide() end if money > 0 then button.money = money else button.money = nil end if InboxFrame.openMailID == index then button:SetChecked(1) else button:SetChecked(nil) end else getglobal("MailItem"..i.."ExpireTime"):Hide() getglobal("MailItem"..i.."Button"):Hide() getglobal("MailItem"..i.."Subject"):SetText("") getglobal("MailItem"..i.."Sender"):SetText("") end index = index + 1 end -- Page arrows (ref l.188-198): back is dead on the first page, forward is dead once -- this page reaches the end of the list. `lastOnPage` is the list index this page's -- last row would carry if it were full. local lastOnPage = MailFrame.pageNum * BENILLA_INBOXITEMS_TO_DISPLAY if MailFrame.pageNum == 1 then InboxPrevPageButton:Disable() else InboxPrevPageButton:Enable() end if lastOnPage < numItems then InboxNextPageButton:Enable() else InboxNextPageButton:Disable() end -- InboxCurrentPage is declared in the ref XML (l.329) but NO reference Lua ever writes -- it — the real 1.12 window shows nothing there, so neither do we. end
-- Row click: open / close the letter (ref InboxFrame_OnClick l.201-213; this = the button). function InboxFrame_OnClick(index) if not this:GetChecked() then InboxFrame.openMailID = 0 HideUIPanel(OpenMailFrame) else InboxFrame.openMailID = index OpenMail_Update() PlaySound("igSpellBookOpen") ShowUIPanel(OpenMailFrame) end InboxFrame_Update() end
-- Row hover: the enclosed item (SetInboxItem) + the enclosed-money / COD lines (ref -- InboxFrameItem_OnEnter l.215-240; this = the button). function InboxFrameItem_OnEnter() local button = this GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") if button.hasItem then GameTooltip:SetInboxItem(button.index) end if button.money then if button.hasItem then GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") end GameTooltip:AddLine("Enclosed amount", "", 1, 1, 1) -- ENCLOSED_MONEY SetTooltipMoney(GameTooltip, button.money) elseif button.cod then if button.hasItem then GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") end GameTooltip:AddLine("Cash on Delivery Amount:", "", 1, 1, 1) -- COD_AMOUNT SetTooltipMoney(GameTooltip, button.cod) end GameTooltip:Show() end
function InboxNextPage() PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") MailFrame.pageNum = MailFrame.pageNum + 1 InboxFrame_Update() end function InboxPrevPage() PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") MailFrame.pageNum = MailFrame.pageNum - 1 InboxFrame_Update() end
-- ── Open letter (ref OpenMailFrame_OnHide l.256-272 / OpenMail_Update l.274-432) ───────── function OpenMailFrame_OnHide() StaticPopup_Hide("DELETE_MAIL") if not InboxFrame.openMailID or InboxFrame.openMailID == 0 then InboxFrame_Update() PlaySound("igSpellBookClose") return end local pkg, sta, sender, subject, money, cod, days, itemID, wasRead, wasReturned, textCreated = GetInboxHeaderInfo(InboxFrame.openMailID) if money == 0 and not itemID and textCreated then DeleteInboxItem(InboxFrame.openMailID) end InboxFrame.openMailID = 0 PlaySound("igSpellBookClose") InboxFrame_Update() end
-- One GlobalString read — the player's own table, executed off their chain at boot and -- absent in a bare-XML harness. (AuctionFrame.xml carries the twin of this; the static -- labels below take theirs through `text=` instead, which the loader resolves the same way.) local function gs(key, fallback) local value = getglobal(key) if value and value ~= "" then return value end return fallback or "" end
-- The auction house's RECEIPT (ref l.300-362). An auction mail's body is machine-written -- bookkeeping, not prose — the engine parses it (`ui_mail::invoice`) and hands back seven -- values; this lays them out. The guard is on `playerName`, the THIRD value, because that -- is the one the miss tail nils: an invoice whose counterparty has not been named yet is -- not renderable, and the row re-resolves when the name query lands. -- -- Two shapes off one pane. A SELLER's is the full sum — sale price, plus what the deposit -- refunds, minus the house's cut, ruled off and totalled. A BUYER's is a single line: what -- you paid. The difference is not just which lines show, it is where the total and the -- rule sit, so both get re-anchored every time. local function OpenMail_UpdateInvoice(isInvoice, id) local invoiceType, itemName, playerName, bid, buyout, deposit, consignment if isInvoice then invoiceType, itemName, playerName, bid, buyout, deposit, consignment = GetInboxInvoiceInfo(id) end if not playerName then OpenMailInvoiceFrame:Hide() return end -- Paid the asking price, or won it on a bid? `bid == buyout` is the whole test. local buyMode = "(" .. gs(bid == buyout and "BUYOUT" or "HIGH_BIDDER") .. ")" if invoiceType == "buyer" then OpenMailInvoiceItemLabel:SetText(gs("ITEM_PURCHASED_COLON") .. " " .. itemName .. " " .. buyMode) OpenMailInvoicePurchaser:SetText(gs("SOLD_BY_COLON") .. " " .. playerName) OpenMailInvoiceBuyMode:SetText("") OpenMailInvoiceAmountReceived:SetText(gs("AMOUNT_PAID_COLON")) -- One line, so the total rides up to where the sale price would have been. OpenMailInvoiceAmountReceived:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "OpenMailInvoiceSalePrice", "TOPRIGHT", 0, 0) OpenMailArithmeticLine:SetPoint("TOP", "OpenMailInvoicePurchaser", "BOTTOMLEFT", 125, 0) MoneyFrame_Update("OpenMailTransactionAmountMoneyFrame", bid) OpenMailInvoiceSalePrice:Hide() OpenMailInvoiceDeposit:Hide() OpenMailInvoiceHouseCut:Hide() OpenMailSalePriceMoneyFrame:Hide() OpenMailDepositMoneyFrame:Hide() OpenMailHouseCutMoneyFrame:Hide() else OpenMailInvoiceItemLabel:SetText(gs("ITEM_SOLD_COLON") .. " " .. itemName) OpenMailInvoicePurchaser:SetText(gs("PURCHASED_BY_COLON") .. " " .. playerName) OpenMailInvoiceBuyMode:SetText(buyMode) OpenMailInvoiceAmountReceived:SetText(gs("AMOUNT_RECEIVED_COLON")) OpenMailArithmeticLine:SetPoint("TOP", "OpenMailInvoiceHouseCut", "BOTTOMRIGHT", 0, 9) OpenMailInvoiceAmountReceived:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "OpenMailInvoiceHouseCut", "BOTTOMRIGHT", 0, -18) MoneyFrame_Update("OpenMailDepositMoneyFrame", deposit) MoneyFrame_Update("OpenMailSalePriceMoneyFrame", bid) MoneyFrame_Update("OpenMailHouseCutMoneyFrame", consignment) -- The cut is the one number that leaves — red, and the only recoloured line. SetMoneyFrameColor("OpenMailHouseCutMoneyFrame", 1.0, 0, 0) MoneyFrame_Update("OpenMailTransactionAmountMoneyFrame", bid + deposit - consignment) OpenMailInvoiceSalePrice:Show() OpenMailInvoiceDeposit:Show() OpenMailInvoiceHouseCut:Show() OpenMailSalePriceMoneyFrame:Show() OpenMailDepositMoneyFrame:Show() OpenMailHouseCutMoneyFrame:Show() end OpenMailInvoiceFrame:Show() end
function OpenMail_Update() local id = InboxFrame.openMailID if not id or id == 0 then return end local packageIcon, stationeryIcon, sender, subject, money, CODAmount, daysLeft, hasItem, wasRead, wasReturned, textCreated, canReply = GetInboxHeaderInfo(id) if not sender or not canReply then OpenMailReplyButton:Disable() else OpenMailReplyButton:Enable() end if not sender then sender = "Unknown" end OpenMailSender:SetText(sender) OpenMailSubject:SetText(subject) -- SetPortraitToTexture, not SetTexture (ref l.174). The stationery icon is an ordinary -- square ITEM icon (`INV_Misc_Note_01`), and the portrait ring is a thin band with -- transparent corners — set raw, the icon's dark border shows through them as four -- little squares around the circle (director's report, 2026-08-22). The reference -- reaches for the portrait verb here and nowhere else in this file for exactly that -- reason: the INBOX window's ring holds `Mail-Icon`, purpose-drawn art that needs no -- crop, and the reference leaves that one raw too (ref l.258, and so do we). SetPortraitToTexture("OpenMailFrameIcon", stationeryIcon) local bodyText, texture, isTakeable, isInvoice = GetInboxText(id) OpenMail_UpdateInvoice(isInvoice, id) -- Unconditional, exactly as the reference writes it (ref l.293) — and it is safe to be -- unconditional because `bodyText` is **nil** for an invoice: the engine's own -- `GetInboxText` carve-out, not this file's (decision 1527). The receipt therefore has -- nothing to sit on top of. OpenMailBodyText:SetText(bodyText) if texture then OpenStationeryBackgroundLeft:SetTexture(BENILLA_STATIONERY_PATH..texture.."1") OpenStationeryBackgroundRight:SetTexture(BENILLA_STATIONERY_PATH..texture.."2") end local hasAttachments -- The letter button — "make a permanent copy" (ref l.364-376): a takeable body not yet -- copied shows the stationery icon; the package button chains off its RIGHT, else -- collapses onto its LEFT so the row stays packed. if isTakeable and not textCreated then getglobal("OpenMailLetterButtonIcon"):SetTexture(stationeryIcon) OpenMailLetterButton:Enable() OpenMailLetterButton:Show() OpenMailPackageButton:SetPoint("LEFT", "OpenMailLetterButton", "RIGHT", 10, 0) hasAttachments = 1 else OpenMailLetterButton:Hide() OpenMailPackageButton:SetPoint("LEFT", "OpenMailLetterButton", "LEFT", 0, 0) end local name, itemTexture, count, quality, canUse = GetInboxItem(id) if name then OpenMailFrame.itemName = name getglobal("OpenMailPackageButtonIcon"):SetTexture(itemTexture) if (count or 1) > 1 then getglobal("OpenMailPackageButtonCount"):SetText(count) else getglobal("OpenMailPackageButtonCount"):SetText("") end if canUse then getglobal("OpenMailPackageButtonIcon"):SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) else getglobal("OpenMailPackageButtonIcon"):SetVertexColor(1.0, 0.1, 0.1) end OpenMailPackageButton:Show() OpenMailPackageButton:Enable() OpenMailMoneyButton:SetPoint("LEFT", "OpenMailPackageButton", "RIGHT", 10, 0) hasAttachments = 1 else OpenMailPackageButton:Hide() OpenMailFrame.itemName = nil OpenMailMoneyButton:SetPoint("LEFT", "OpenMailPackageButton", "LEFT", 0, 0) end if CODAmount > 0 then OpenMailFrame.cod = CODAmount else OpenMailFrame.cod = nil end if money == 0 then OpenMailMoneyButton:Hide() OpenMailFrame.money = nil else getglobal("OpenMailMoneyButtonIcon"):SetTexture("Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Coin_01") OpenMailMoneyButton:Enable() OpenMailMoneyButton:Show() OpenMailFrame.money = money hasAttachments = 1 end if InboxItemCanDelete(id) then OpenMailDeleteButton:SetText("Delete") -- DELETE else OpenMailDeleteButton:SetText("Return") -- MAIL_RETURN end -- The caption + its two positions (ref l.422-431: BOTTOM -68,123 attachments / -5,123 none). if hasAttachments then OpenMailAttachmentText:SetText("Take Attachments:") -- TAKE_ATTACHMENTS OpenMailAttachmentText:SetTextColor(1, 1, 1) OpenMailAttachmentText:SetPoint("BOTTOM", "OpenMailFrame", "BOTTOM", -68, 123) else OpenMailAttachmentText:SetText("No Attachments") -- NO_ATTACHMENTS OpenMailAttachmentText:SetTextColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) OpenMailAttachmentText:SetPoint("BOTTOM", "OpenMailFrame", "BOTTOM", -5, 123) end end
-- Reply → Send tab, prefilled "RE: " (ref OpenMail_Reply l.434-447). function OpenMail_Reply() MailFrameTab_OnClick(2) SendMailNameEditBox:SetText(OpenMailSender:GetText()) local subject = OpenMailSubject:GetText() local prefix = "RE: " -- MAIL_REPLY_PREFIX.." " if string.sub(subject, 1, string.len(prefix)) ~= prefix then subject = prefix..subject end SendMailSubjectEditBox:SetText(subject) SendMailBodyEditBox:SetFocus() SendMailFrame.sendMode = "reply" end
function OpenMail_Delete() local id = InboxFrame.openMailID if InboxItemCanDelete(id) then if OpenMailFrame.itemName then StaticPopup_Show("DELETE_MAIL", OpenMailFrame.itemName) return elseif OpenMailFrame.money then StaticPopup_Show("DELETE_MONEY") return else DeleteInboxItem(id) end else ReturnInboxItem(id) StaticPopup_Hide("COD_CONFIRMATION") end InboxFrame.openMailID = 0 HideUIPanel(OpenMailFrame) end
function BenillaOpenMailMoneyButton_OnClick() TakeInboxMoney(InboxFrame.openMailID) end -- Hovering the coins shows the plain money tooltip (ref OpenMailMoneyButton OnEnter -- l.1823-1829: no header line, just the amount). function BenillaOpenMailMoneyButton_OnEnter(button) if OpenMailFrame.money then GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") SetTooltipMoney(GameTooltip, OpenMailFrame.money) GameTooltip:Show() end end -- The letter button: copy the body into a bag item (ref OpenMailLetterButton OnClick -- l.1744-1747 → CMSG_MAIL_CREATE_TEXT_ITEM; the OK result stamps COPIED server-side, and -- the list re-sync hides the button via textCreated). function BenillaOpenMailLetterButton_OnClick() TakeInboxTextItem(InboxFrame.openMailID) PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") end -- Take the item; a COD parcel confirms first (ref OpenMailPackageButton OnClick l.1778-1787). function BenillaOpenMailPackageButton_OnClick() if OpenMailFrame.cod then StaticPopup_Show("COD_CONFIRMATION") else TakeInboxItem(InboxFrame.openMailID) end PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") end function OpenMailPackage_OnEnter() local button = this GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetInboxItem(InboxFrame.openMailID) if OpenMailFrame.cod then SetTooltipMoney(GameTooltip, OpenMailFrame.cod) end GameTooltip:Show() end
-- ── Send tab (ref SendMail* l.484-611 / l.936-960) ────────────────────────────────────── function SendMailMailButton_OnClick() local copper = BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper("SendMailMoney") if SendMailSendMoneyButton:GetChecked() then SetSendMailCOD(0) if copper > 0 then StaticPopup_Show("SEND_MONEY", SendMailNameEditBox:GetText()) this:Disable() return end SetSendMailMoney(0) else SetSendMailMoney(0) SetSendMailCOD(copper) end SendMailFrame_SendMail() this:Disable() end
function SendMailFrame_SendMail() SendMail(SendMailNameEditBox:GetText(), SendMailSubjectEditBox:GetText(), SendMailBodyEditBox:GetText()) end
function SendMailFrame_Update() local itemName, itemTexture, stackCount, quality = GetSendMailItem() getglobal("SendMailPackageButtonIcon"):SetTexture(itemTexture) if (stackCount or 1) <= 1 then stackCount = "" end if itemName then SendMailCODButton:Enable() SendMailCODButtonText:SetTextColor(1.0, 0.82, 0) if SendMailSubjectEditBox:GetText() == "" or SendMailSubjectEditBox:GetText() == SendMailFrame.previousItem then SendMailSubjectEditBox:SetText(itemName) SendMailFrame.previousItem = itemName end else if SendMailSubjectEditBox:GetText() == SendMailFrame.previousItem then SendMailSubjectEditBox:SetText("") end SendMailRadioButton_OnClick(1) SendMailFrame.previousItem = "" SendMailCODButton:Disable() SendMailCODButtonText:SetTextColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) end getglobal("SendMailPackageButtonCount"):SetText(stackCount) BenillaMoney_Set("SendMailMoneyFrame", GetMoney()) -- The 30c postage (ref l.542-547); red when it exceeds the purse. BenillaMoney_Set("SendMailCost", GetSendMailPrice()) if GetSendMailPrice() > GetMoney() then BenillaMoney_SetColor("SendMailCost", 1.0, 0.1, 0.1) else BenillaMoney_SetColor("SendMailCost", 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) end SendMailFrame_CanSend() end
function SendMailFrame_Reset() SendMailNameEditBox:SetText("") SendMailSubjectEditBox:SetText("") SendMailBodyEditBox:SetText("") BenillaMoneyInput_ResetMoney("SendMailMoney") SendMailRadioButton_OnClick(1) SendMailFrame_Update() end
-- SendMailFrame_CanSend (ref l.564-598): name + subject required (stationery is always the -- default here — the picker is omitted); a COD send additionally caps at 10,000g. function SendMailFrame_CanSend() local checks = 0 local checksRequired = 2 if string.len(SendMailNameEditBox:GetText()) > 0 then checks = checks + 1 end if string.len(SendMailSubjectEditBox:GetText()) > 0 then checks = checks + 1 end if SendMailCODButton:GetChecked() then checksRequired = 3 if BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper("SendMailMoney") > BENILLA_MAX_COD_AMOUNT * 10000 then SendMailErrorText:Show() SendMailErrorCoin:Show() else SendMailErrorText:Hide() SendMailErrorCoin:Hide() checks = checks + 1 end else SendMailErrorText:Hide() SendMailErrorCoin:Hide() end if checks == checksRequired then SendMailMailButton:Enable() else SendMailMailButton:Disable() end end
function SendMailRadioButton_OnClick(index) if index == 1 then SendMailCODButton:SetChecked(nil) SendMailSendMoneyButton:SetChecked(1) SendMailMoneyText:SetText("Amount to send:") -- AMOUNT_TO_SEND else SendMailCODButton:SetChecked(1) SendMailSendMoneyButton:SetChecked(nil) SendMailMoneyText:SetText("Cash on Delivery Amount:") -- COD_AMOUNT end PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") SendMailFrame_CanSend() end
-- The send item slot: a cursor drop (ref SendMailPackageButton_OnClick l.709-721; the cursor -- MONEY drop path is omitted with the cursor-money system). function SendMailPackageButton_OnClick() ClickSendMailItemButton() SendMailFrame_Update() end
-- ── The window-owned StaticPopups (ref StaticPopup.lua l.205/220/234/252; the DeathFrame.xml -- house convention). Money frames omitted (the shared engine's money variant is inert). ── StaticPopupDialogs["COD_CONFIRMATION"] = { -- l.205 text = "Accepting this item will cost:", -- COD_CONFIRMATION button1 = "Accept", button2 = "Cancel", OnAccept = function() TakeInboxItem(InboxFrame.openMailID) end, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, } StaticPopupDialogs["DELETE_MAIL"] = { -- l.220 text = "Deleting this mail will also destroy %s", -- DELETE_MAIL_CONFIRMATION button1 = "Accept", button2 = "Cancel", OnAccept = function() DeleteInboxItem(InboxFrame.openMailID) InboxFrame.openMailID = 0 HideUIPanel(OpenMailFrame) end, showAlert = 1, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, } StaticPopupDialogs["DELETE_MONEY"] = { -- l.234 text = "Deleting this mail will also destroy the enclosed money.", -- DELETE_MONEY_CONFIRMATION (money line omitted) button1 = "Accept", button2 = "Cancel", OnAccept = function() DeleteInboxItem(InboxFrame.openMailID) InboxFrame.openMailID = 0 HideUIPanel(OpenMailFrame) end, showAlert = 1, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, } StaticPopupDialogs["SEND_MONEY"] = { -- l.252 text = "Really send %s the following amount?", -- SEND_MONEY_CONFIRMATION button1 = "Accept", button2 = "Cancel", OnAccept = function() if SetSendMailMoney(BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper("SendMailMoney")) then SendMailFrame_SendMail() end end, OnCancel = function() SendMailMailButton:Enable() end, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, }

Scripts.OnEnter: if ( not this.tooltip ) then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(this.tooltip)

Scripts.OnMouseUp: SendMailBodyEditBox:SetFocus() if ( CursorHasItem() ) then SendMailPackageButton_OnClick() end

Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") if ( GetSendMailItem() ) then GameTooltip:SetSendMailItem() else GameTooltip:SetText("Attach an item to send.", 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) end

Scripts.OnHide: CloseMail() CloseBackpack() HideUIPanel(OpenMailFrame) SendMailBodyEditBox:SetText("") SendMailNameEditBox:SetText("") SendMailSubjectEditBox:SetText("") PlaySound("igCharacterInfoClose")

Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText("Click to make a permanent\ncopy of this letter.")

Scripts.OnShow: local centre = GetCenterFrame() if centre then HideUIPanel(centre) end
